class.name: ResourceImporterGIF
class.brief_description: Imports a [code].gif[/code] file as an animated [GIFTexture].
class.description: Default importer for [code].gif[/code] files. Decodes the animation into a [GIFTexture], which plays back in any node accepting a [Texture2D]. To import the same file as a [SpriteFrames] for [AnimatedSprite2D] instead, select [b]SpriteFrames[/b] in the Import dock's Import As dropdown ([ResourceImporterGIFFrames]).

members.member: If [code]true[/code], compresses baked frame textures (VRAM/WebP depending on project settings) to reduce memory use at the cost of quality and load time.

[b]Store[/b]: frame textures are baked during import and stored in the imported resource. [b]Generate On Load[/b]: only source data is stored; frames are generated on first use, trading startup cost for smaller imports.
Dithers semi-transparent pixels when baking, improving edges on backgrounds that do not match the GIF's transparency color.
